environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Basic tier B1) behind Azure Application Gateway with no WAF policy attached. The application is directly accessible via the App Gateway's public IP. No middleware rate limiting is configured in the application. The LDAP server (Windows Server 2022 AD DS) accepts connections from the App Service's outbound IPs via VNet integration. The service account used for LDAP binding has read access to the entire directory tree.

config.gateway: Azure Application Gateway Standard_v2 (no WAF SKU)
config.network: VNet integrated, LDAP port 389 open to app subnet
